Class PreOrderCreateEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
de.eldoria.companies.events.order.PreOrderCreateEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
CancellableWithReason, OwnerProvider, org.bukkit.event.Cancellable
public class PreOrderCreateEvent extends org.bukkit.event.Event implements OwnerProvider, CancellableWithReason
An order is about to be created, by a player or through the API.

Fired on the main thread before the owner is charged. Listeners may change the draft(): rename it, change, remove or add lines. Once all listeners ran, the server's limits are checked again and the fee is computed from the adjusted price. A draft that breaks the limits or has no lines left is not created and nothing is charged.

Cancelling the event stops the creation and nothing is charged. A player sees the reason; an API caller gets it in its rejection.

The event fires only on the server where the order is created.
